May TRXX use your money answers?

Three quick questions come next. They are about your money, so we ask first.

What TRXX will process Your income pattern, payday, today's balances and what is due before payday.
Why Only to work out Safe to Spend. Never sold, never for ads or credit offers.
Where it is stored Encrypted on TRXX servers, apart from your name and number.
You'll get a receipt and can withdraw any time Withdraw in Me, Privacy & consents. Your answers are then deleted.
Required to continue.

Use AI to word explanations Off · change any time

Turns results into everyday sentences. Off, you get clear fixed templates.

Numbers never come from the AI. TRXX's own rules calculate every amount. If on, only the facts to be worded are sent, never your name or account numbers, and may be processed outside Egypt.

Why trust TRXX

Specific promises, not slogans: what TRXX never does, and how it earns.

TRXX never…
holds your money. It stays in your bank and wallet.
moves money without your approval. Then only through your own bank or wallet.
ranks offers by what it earns. It earns the same whichever you choose.
sells your data. Or passes your details on as leads.
shows ads. No paid placement, anywhere.
asks for your bank or wallet OTP, PIN, CVV or passwords. Or for any code by phone, SMS or chat.

How TRXX makes money

The daily loop is free Safe to Spend, Daily Brief, basic Ask TRXX, alerts, Subscription Rescue and fee detection.
TRXX Plus An optional subscription you pay for
Referral fees, only if you apply One flat, disclosed fee, the same for every provider. It never changes the order. EGP 0 if you pay cash or do nothing.
TRXX Promise Terms

If we miss a reminder we promised and you're charged a late fee, we refund it up to EGP 150.

  • You confirmed it, and our reminder was missing, late or wrong through our error.
  • We refund the late-fee line only, not interest.
  • We spot the miss and tell you first, in the app. Never by SMS or link.
  • Refunded within 5 working days, as Plus credit or a transfer from TRXX.
